from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,os,subprocess,sys,shutil,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
ROOT=Path('${CBUS_TOOLKIT_ROOT}');OUT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;WHEELROOT=Path('${CBUS_WHEEL_ACCEPTANCE_ROOT}');SOURCE=ROOT/'src/cbus_toolkit';INSTALLED=WHEELROOT/'installed-env/lib/python3.13/site-packages/cbus_toolkit';BIN=Path('${CBUS_CARGO_TARGET}/release/cmqttd')
SELECTION=[
 'tests/test_cgate_contract_inventory.py::test_inventory_is_deterministic_and_covers_both_routing_inventories',

 'tests/test_parity_register.py::ParityRegisterTests::test_evidence_invalidation_is_recomputed_from_a_source_checkout',
 'tests/test_parity_register.py::ParityRegisterTests::test_packaged_closure_receipt_closes_only_verified_items',
 'tests/test_cgate_session_differential.py::test_passed_receipt_rejects_missing_or_stale_source_binding',
 'tests/test_cgate_session_differential.py::test_cmqttd_receipt_is_separate_and_fully_executed',
 'tests/test_cgate_tagged_session_differential.py::test_committed_receipt_binds_full_wire_oracle_and_current_source',
 'tests/test_cgate_tagged_session_differential.py::test_receipt_rejects_raw_tag_tamper_and_stale_transitive_rust_source',
 'tests/test_dlt_physical_programming_interop.py',
 'tests/test_cmqtt_programming_methods_interop.py::test_real_cli_programs_all_ten_methods_through_one_routed_session',
 'tests/test_cmqtt_programming_methods_interop.py::test_completed_save_journal_records_every_phase',
 'tests/test_cmqtt_programming_methods_interop.py::test_incomplete_journal_refuses_repeat_saves_before_io_until_recovered']
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def roster(p):return {str(f.relative_to(p)):sha(f) for f in sorted(p.rglob('*')) if f.is_file() and f.suffix in ('.py','.json')}
def bindings():return {'package':roster(SOURCE),'installed_package':roster(INSTALLED),'cmqttd_sha256':sha(BIN),'wheel_sha256':sha(next((WHEELROOT/'wheels').glob('*.whl'))),'tests':{str(f.relative_to(ROOT)):sha(f) for f in sorted((ROOT/'tests').rglob('*.py'))},'fixtures':{str(f.relative_to(ROOT)):sha(f) for f in sorted((ROOT/'research/fixtures').glob('cgate-*.json'))},'native_manifest_sha256':sha(ROOT/'research/release-gates/native.json')}
plugin=OUT/'interop_record.py'
assert plugin.exists()
mode=sys.argv[1];run=OUT/('python-'+mode+'-final');run.mkdir(mode=0o700);py=ROOT/'.venv/bin/python' if mode=='source' else WHEELROOT/'installed-env/bin/python';expected=SOURCE if mode=='source' else INSTALLED
before=bindings();assert before['package']==before['installed_package'];assert before['cmqttd_sha256']==json.loads((OUT/'rust-checks.json').read_text())['release_binaries']['cmqttd']
env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('CBUS_')};env.update(PYTHONPATH=('src:' if mode=='source' else '')+'tests:.:'+str(OUT),PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1',PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD='1',CBUS_CMQTTD_BIN=str(BIN),INTEROP_RECORD_DIR=str(run/'events'))
probe='import cbus_toolkit,cbus_toolkit.cli,cbus_toolkit.parity,json;print(json.dumps({n.__name__:n.__file__ for n in (cbus_toolkit,cbus_toolkit.cli,cbus_toolkit.parity)}))'
origins=json.loads(subprocess.check_output([str(py),'-c',probe],cwd=ROOT,env=env,text=True));assert all(Path(p).resolve().is_relative_to(expected) for p in origins.values())
argv=[str(py),'-m','pytest','-q',*SELECTION,'-p','no:cacheprovider','-p','interop_record','--basetemp='+str(run/'cases'),'--junitxml='+str(run/'junit.xml')]
(run/'before.json').write_text(json.dumps({'inputs':before,'origins':origins,'argv':argv,'selection':SELECTION},indent=2)+'\n')
with (run/'pytest.log').open('w') as f:r=subprocess.run(argv,cwd=ROOT,env=env,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
after=bindings();assert after==before
xml=ET.parse(run/'junit.xml');cases=xml.findall('.//testcase');identities=[(c.get('classname'),c.get('name')) for c in cases];assert len(identities)==len(set(identities))
events=[json.loads(line) for p in sorted((run/'events').glob('*.jsonl')) for line in p.read_text().splitlines()];cli=[e for e in events if e['kind']=='in-process-cli.main' or (e['kind']=='subprocess.run' and isinstance(e['argv'],list) and e['argv'][1:3]==['-m','cbus_toolkit'])]
live=[row for row in subprocess.check_output(['ps','-axo','pid=,command='],text=True).splitlines() if str(BIN) in row and str(run/'cases') in row]
receipt={'exit':r.returncode,'parents':len(cases),'failures':len(xml.findall('.//failure')),'errors':len(xml.findall('.//error')),'skips':len(xml.findall('.//skipped')),'identities':identities,'source_bindings_stable':True,'installed_package_matches_source':True,'actual_import_origins':origins,'cli_events':len(cli),'cli_exit_counts':{str(code):sum(e['exit']==code for e in cli) for code in sorted({e['exit'] for e in cli},key=str)},'owned_daemons_left':live,'pytest_subtests_not_added_to_parent_counts':True}
(run/'after.json').write_text(json.dumps({'inputs':after},indent=2)+'\n');(run/'receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in receipt.items() if k not in ('identities','actual_import_origins')}));assert not live and not any(receipt[k] for k in ('failures','errors','skips'));sys.exit(r.returncode)
